subject: Mythology
title: The San Bushmen: Kaggen the Mantis God
description: A fast breakdown of The San Bushmen: Kaggen the Mantis God for builders.

hook.text: The San people of Southern Africa worship a praying mantis as their creator god and supreme trickster.

buildup.text: Kaggen made the moon from an old shoe, created the eland antelope, and brought fire from the ostrich's armpit.

discovery.text: He is a shape-shifter who can become any animal. His myths are painted on rock walls dating back 20,000 years.

twist.text: San mythology may be the oldest surviving religious tradition on earth, predating every major world religion.

climax.text: Rock art showing Kaggen's stories stretches across Southern Africa in one of the largest art galleries ever created.

punchline.text: The oldest mythology on earth stars a praying mantis who made the moon.

quiz.question: Why is San mythology significant in the history of religion?
options: It influenced all other African mythologies
It may be the oldest surviving religious tradition on earth
It was the first mythology to be written down
